import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Tuple

@dataclass
class FlagRule:
    name: str
    pattern: str
    weight: int

    # High-level risk markers (avoid operational details)

def score_text(text: str, rules: List[FlagRule] = RULES) -> Tuple[int, List[str]]:
